title: Sentinel Hub / EO Browser skill roadmap

beginner.title: Get started with Sentinel Hub / EO Browser
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Sentinel Hub / EO Browser, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Open and explore
beginner.outcome: You can: explore places and layers
beginner.practice: Explore and measure an area you know

beginner.title: Imagery basics
beginner.outcome: You can: read satellite and aerial imagery
beginner.practice: Compare two dates over the same area

intermediate.title: Analyse change
intermediate.outcome: You can: detect and quantify change
intermediate.practice: Measure vegetation change over a season

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Sentinel Hub / EO Browser
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Sentinel Hub / EO Browser distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Sentinel Hub / EO Browser
expert.outcome: You can: use Sentinel Hub / EO Browser's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Scale and automate
expert.outcome: You can: analyse large areas reliably

expert.title: Integrate Sentinel Hub / EO Browser into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Sentinel Hub / EO Browser with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Sentinel Hub / EO Browser to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Sentinel Hub / EO Browser well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Sentinel Hub / EO Browser" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
